findings.current: We’d been ambushed once before we’d even come down from the mountain range. Since then, we’d let the enemy catch up three times.
findings.defect: “Since then” makes the first attack separate from the three pursuits; the source counts it as the first of three.
findings.rationale: 첫 습격을 시작으로 identifies the early attack as the start of the three pursuits.
findings.replacement: The first attack had come before we’d even made it all the way down from the mountain range. By now, the enemy had caught up with us three times.
findings.source: 산맥을 완전히 내려오기도 전에 있었던 첫 습격을 시작으로, 이미 세 번이나 적들의 추격을 허용한 상황.

findings.current: They were no longer alive, but they weren’t dead, either—and for the same reason, they’d forgotten how to feel. They couldn’t even get tired.
findings.defect: The draft says they were not dead; the source says they had not died but were already as good as dead.
findings.rationale: 죽지 않았으나 이미 죽은 것이나 다름없는 preserves the distinction between not having died and being as good as dead.
findings.replacement: They hadn’t died, yet they were already as good as dead. They’d forgotten sensation, and for the same reason, they couldn’t even feel fatigue.
findings.source: 죽지 않았으나 이미 죽은 것이나 다름없는 존재이기에 감각도 잊었으며, 그와 같은 이유로 피로조차 느끼지 못한다.

findings.current: When you fall behind, we can leave it behind.
findings.defect: The threat is to abandon Jeong Hogun, not the armor.
findings.rationale: 뒤처졌을 때 refers to Jeong falling behind; the implicit object of 버리고 가면 is him.
findings.replacement: When you fall behind, we can just leave you behind.
findings.source: 나중에 뒤처졌을 때 버리고 가면 그만이니까.

findings.defect: Jin’s polite address to Ju Hwaran becomes an intimate first-name address.
findings.rationale: 주 소저 explicitly marks his respectful address while he sides with Song Ilseom’s assessment.

findings.current: Even if I’d been Shakyamuni himself, I’d have cursed the heavens and cracked Great Sir over the head with a wooden fish.
findings.defect: “Cursed the heavens” removes the profane parody of Buddhist invocations.
findings.rationale: 아미시벌 관세음뒤짐 turns Buddhist names into an expletive and a death wish; the blasphemous joke is the point of the line.
findings.replacement: Even Shakyamuni himself would have shouted, “Amitabha, fuck this! Guanyin, drop dead!” and cracked Great Sir’s skull with a wooden fish.
findings.source: 설령 내가 아니라 석가모니라 할지라도 아미시벌 관세음뒤짐을 외치며 목탁으로 대인의 뚝배기를 깼을 것이다.

findings.current: Toward our destination, far to the east: Qinghai, where our allies—including the Kunlun Sect—were waiting.
findings.defect: The draft states the allies’ presence as certain; the source presents it as an expectation.
findings.rationale: 머무르고 있을 conveys Jin’s expectation rather than confirmed knowledge.
findings.replacement: Toward our destination far to the east, where our allies in Qinghai—including the Kunlun Sect—should be waiting.
findings.source: 우리의 목적지, 곤륜파를 비롯한 청해성의 아군들이 머무르고 있을 저 머나먼 동쪽으로.

summary: The draft changes the number of pursuits, reverses an explanation of the undead, and changes who would be left behind. It also loses a register distinction and a Buddhist profanity joke.
